It was -- Della Miles owned the apartment building and it was over on 36 -- 36th place across Jefferson. And Della Miles was her name. She was married to one of the guys from Buffalo, Marshall Miles -- years ago. And Marshall was -- he was one of the guys that had some money up backing Joe Louis and things like that way back in those days. He was from a family that had money around Buffalo.
